title: Bolt's Groove
logline: A shy service robot finds unexpected joy and acceptance by learning to dance at a vibrant rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, self-expression, joy of connection

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A meticulous, shy service robot with a hidden desire to move.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A lively, empathetic human party-goer who encourages Bolt.

characters.name: Party-goers
characters.one_line_description: Diverse group of humans enjoying the rooftop party.

scenes.title: Observing the Rhythm
scenes.summary: Bolt stands awkwardly at the edge of a vibrant rooftop party, watching the dancing crowd with a longing but hesitant gaze. Maya notices him.
scenes.setting: Edge of a lively rooftop party with city lights in the background.

scenes.title: An Invitation to Dance
scenes.summary: Maya approaches Bolt with a warm smile, extending a hand and gesturing for him to join the dance floor. Bolt hesitates, his internal processors whirring.
scenes.setting: Near the dance floor, slightly away from the main crowd.

scenes.title: First Awkward Steps
scenes.summary: Bolt makes his first tentative, stiff movements on the dance floor, mimicking Maya's simpler steps. He's clumsy but determined, drawing a few amused smiles.
scenes.setting: The illuminated dance floor, surrounded by other dancers.

scenes.title: Finding the Groove
scenes.summary: As Maya continues to guide him, Bolt starts to loosen up. His movements become smoother, more rhythmic, and he even tries a small, unique robot-inspired spin. His confidence grows visibly.

scenes.title: The Dance of Acceptance
scenes.summary: Bolt is now fully immersed, dancing freely and joyfully, incorporating his own unique style. Other party-goers cheer him on, some even trying to imitate his robot moves. He's found his place.
scenes.setting: Center of the lively dance floor, surrounded by cheering crowd.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
